title: introduce-policy-provenance-bridge-with-kms-dual-write-and-region-pin-validation
author: Aisha Moreno
description: Summary: Adds a 'policy provenance bridge' that attaches immutable provenance claims to sensitive requests, dual-writes provenance metadata to KMS-backed envelopes and an append-only compliance ledger, and validates region-pin manifests during request admission. Motivation: Customers requested stronger non-repudiation guarantees for KMS usage and clearer enforcement of tenant region pins without brittle ad-hoc checks. This change ties RBAC v2 decision outputs to a provenance claim that is recorded in two independent backends to make post-hoc audit and compliance investigations more robust. Design: 1) provenance middleware (api/middleware/provenance.go) that gathers RBAC decision context, service identity, model id, route, and region pin and emits a canonical claim object; 2) kms-dualwrite daemon (cmd/provenance-daemon) which takes claims and performs an atomic-dual-write: a wrapped KMS envelope (customer CMK context) plus an append to the immutable ledger (ledger client with HMAC anchoring); 3) region-pin validator (api/middleware/region_pin.go) which consults a new region-pin manifest and rejects/rewrites requests failing residency constraints; 4) RBAC mapper extension (rbac/policy_mapper.go) that surfaces assertion hashes used in claims; 5) migration script (scripts/migrate-add-provenance.sh) to backfill policy fingerprints for active tenants. Commits: 4 commits, high-level: create provenance bridge and schema; implement kms-dualwrite and ledger client; add region-pin manifest validation and unit tests; add integration test harness and deployment manifests. Files changed (high level): pkg/provenance/bridge.go, cmd/provenance-daemon/main.go, api/middleware/provenance.go, api/middleware/region_pin.go, rbac/policy_mapper.go, scripts/migrate-add-provenance.sh, deploy/helm/provenance-daemon.yaml, internal/ledger/client.go, tests/integration/provenance_e2e_test.go, tests/unit/region_pin_test.go, docs/security/provenance.md, go.mod. Migration notes: run scripts/migrate-add-provenance.sh in staging to compute policy fingerprints and pre-seed the ledger for active tenants; daemon reads configuration from KMS and LEDGER URIs and requires a new service account with kms:Encrypt/kms:Sign and ledger:Append. Rollout plan: 1) feature flag off by default; 2) enable provenance middleware in Canary region for low-traffic tenants; 3) deploy provenance-daemon in dedicated namespace with scaled-to-zero safe probe; 4) enable region-pin validation in soft-fail mode (log only) for 48h, then hard-enforce. Testing: unit tests for policy_mapper and region_pin, synchronous integration tests that assert dual-write atomicity via ledger stub, e2e tests that exercise full flow with KMS dev envelope. Backwards compatibility: middleware is opt-in; requests without provenance continue to use legacy audit path. Security review: key usage and HSM access patterns documented in docs/security/provenance.md. Release notes: adds provenance bridge and optional KMS dual-write daemon for stronger audit trails and region-pin manifest enforcement. CI and rollout checklists included below.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in provenance bridge that attaches immutable claims to RBAC decisions, a provenance-daemon to dual-write KMS-wrapped envelopes and ledger entries, region-pin manifest validation middleware, migration helper script to backfill policy fingerprints, and docs with operational runbook. Feature gated behind 'provenance_bridge' feature flag. Requires new service account with KMS and ledger permissions.
